description: For arbitrary unary arithmetic formulas \(P,R\), if PA proves \(\forall x(P(x)\leftrightarrow R(x))\), it proves their equivalence after substituting the numeral for the code of any arithmetic sentence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.unary_comparison_instance
  (P R : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula Unit)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.PAEquivalent P R)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.iff
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.numeralInstance P fun x =>
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature A)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.numeralInstance R fun x =>
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature A))
